name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a household living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) as per SECC / BPL list criteria.

benefits: Monthly pension of Rs 200 - Rs 500 from Central Government, supplemented with additional state contribution (totaling Rs 1,000 to Rs 2,500/month depending on state) credited via DBT directly to bank/post office account.
documents_required: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Voter ID)
Bank Passbook Details with IFSC Code
application_process: Obtain IGNOAPS application form from Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office (BDO) in rural areas, or Municipality in urban areas.
Submit form with BPL certificate and age proof.
District Social Welfare Officer sanctions pension and adds beneficiary to monthly DBT disbursement roll.
